field.name: NotificationClient
field.summary: Internal notification transport used to wait for follow-session wake hints.

property.name: WorkingDirectoryOptions
property.summary: Options that control where segmented transfer working directories are created and persisted.

method.name: ResolveToken
method.summary: Resolve the authorization token to use for a request, falling back to the default token if none is provided.
method.param: Optional token to use for the request.

method.name: DisposeCore
method.summary: Release the managed resources used by the client through the synchronous disposal path.

method.name: DisposeAsyncCore
method.summary: Release the managed resources used by the client through the asynchronous disposal path.
method.returns: A value task that completes when asynchronous disposal of notification resources has finished.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Dispose the client and synchronously release any notification transport resources.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Dispose the client and asynchronously release any notification transport resources.
method.returns: A value task that completes when all disposable client resources have been released.

method.name: RegisterFollowSubscriptionAsync
method.summary: Register a persistent follow-session notification subscription when the supplied download session can be mapped to a logical follow subscription.
method.param: Download session whose item, session, and source-session identities determine the persistent notification subscription.
Optional bearer token used for the notification connection.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with a persistent follow notification subscription handle when the session requires one; otherwise null.

method.name: CreateDownloadSessionAsync
method.summary: Create a download session wrapper and, when applicable, attach a persistent follow notification subscription owned for the object lifetime of the session.
method.param: Local working directory storage backing the download session.
Optional bearer token used for authenticated service calls and notification registration.
Current persisted session metadata and transfer state snapshot.
Configured completion behavior for stream-follow downloads.
Optional maximum number of bytes the stream-follow helper should realize before stopping.
Optional buffered follow stream used for stream-follow downloads.
Optional live item being downloaded in the session.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with a download session wrapper bound to any required persistent follow notification subscription.

method.name: TryPromoteStreamFollowToCommittedDownload
method.summary: Attempt to promote a local stream-follow download session into a committed segmented download session by opening the committed download view for the same item and migrating the locally realized stream prefix into the replacement working directory state.
method.param: Current local stream-follow session metadata and persisted state.
Working directory storage that holds the local stream-follow session files to migrate.
Completion behavior to apply to the replacement committed download session.
Optional byte cap to carry into the replacement committed download session.
Optional bearer token used for service calls.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with a committed replacement download session when promotion succeeds; otherwise null.

method.name: PrepareFiniteUploadSource
method.summary: Prepare a finite source description for segmented upload, preferring a stable explicit file-backed source and otherwise producing a working-copy-backed source when needed.
method.param: Finite item whose content stream should be prepared for upload.
Client upload options that may override the temporary staging path.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with a prepared upload source descriptor, optional stream, and any precomputed final full-stream hash metadata, or null when the item has no usable finite source.

method.name: DownloadStreamTransferSegmentToStreamResponse
method.summary: Read a stream-transfer envelope from an HTTP response and copy the payload into the provided destination stream.
method.param: HTTP response containing the stream-transfer envelope or an error payload.
Destination stream that receives the downloaded payload bytes.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the parsed stream-transfer download information, or null when the envelope cannot be validated.

method.name: DownloadStreamTransferSegmentToStreamRequest
method.summary: Issue a stream-transfer request and stream the returned payload directly into the provided destination stream.
method.param: Stream-transfer request describing the target extent to download.
Destination stream that receives the downloaded payload bytes.
Optional bearer token used for the request.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the parsed stream-transfer download information, or null when the request or envelope processing fails.

method.name: DownloadTransferSegmentToStreamResponse
method.summary: Read a segmented transfer envelope from an HTTP response and copy the payload into the provided destination stream.
method.param: HTTP response containing the segmented transfer envelope or an error payload.
Destination stream that receives the downloaded payload bytes.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the parsed segment download information, or null when the envelope cannot be validated.

method.name: DownloadTransferSegmentToStreamRequest
method.summary: Issue a segmented transfer request and stream the returned payload directly into the provided destination stream.
method.param: Segment request describing the target range to download.
Destination stream that receives the downloaded payload bytes.
Optional bearer token used for the request.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the parsed segment download information, or null when the request or envelope processing fails.

method.name: ReadExactlyAsync
method.summary: Read exactly the requested number of bytes from a stream into the provided buffer.
method.param: Source stream to read from.
Destination buffer that must be filled completely.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the full buffer is filled, or false when the stream ends early.

method.name: CreateSessionManager
method.summary: Create the internal session manager used to inspect and mutate persisted local transfer sessions.
method.returns: Session manager scoped to the current working-directory options.

method.name: ResumeCommittedDownload
method.summary: Resume a committed segmented download session by validating local metadata and reopening a fresh committed remote session.
method.param: Persisted local session metadata.
Working-directory storage used to validate persisted local artifacts.
Resume options controlling completion behavior for the reconstructed session.
Optional bearer token used for remote reopen operations.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: A resumed committed download session, or null when validation or reopen fails.

method.name: ResumeSegmentedFollowDownload
method.summary: Resume a segmented follow download session from local working-directory state, reopening the existing remote follower when possible, accepting any server-side promotion to committed mode, and otherwise replacing it with a fresh follower session while preserving usable local state.
method.param: Persisted local session metadata.
Working-directory storage used to validate persisted local artifacts.
Resume options controlling completion behavior for the reconstructed session.
Optional bearer token used for remote reopen or replacement follower operations.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: A resumed segmented follow session, or null when local validation fails and no usable session can be reconstructed.

method.name: ResumeStreamFollowDownload
method.summary: Resume a stream-follow download session from local buffered state, reopening the existing remote follower when possible, otherwise replacing it with a fresh follower session, and finally promoting to a committed download when live follow can no longer be re-established while preserving usable local content.
method.param: Persisted local session metadata.
Working-directory storage used to validate persisted local artifacts.
Resume options controlling completion behavior and future live rebinding.
Optional bearer token used for remote reopen or replacement follower operations.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: A resumed stream-follow session, or null when local validation fails and no usable session can be reconstructed.

method.name: TryPromoteStreamFollowResumeToCommittedDownload
method.summary: Attempt to replace a persisted stream-follow session with a committed segmented download for the same item while preserving the locally downloaded contiguous stream prefix.
method.param: Persisted local stream-follow session metadata.
Working-directory storage used to read the local stream prefix and migrate the resumed session identity.
Resume options controlling completion behavior for the promoted committed session.
Optional bearer token used to open the replacement committed session.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: A committed segmented download session bound to the existing local session identity, or null when promotion cannot be completed safely.

method.name: CreateResumedStreamFollowSession
method.summary: Create a client-facing stream-follow download session from locally persisted state, optionally rebinding a live when requested.
method.param: Persisted local session metadata.
Working-directory storage used to read local stream-follow artifacts.
Resume options controlling completion behavior and optional live rebinding.
Optional bearer token retained by the resumed session for later remote follow operations.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: A reconstructed stream-follow download session, or null when the local buffered state cannot be reopened.

method.name: ValidateSegmentedDownloadObjectPayload
method.summary: Validate that the locally persisted segmented download object payload still matches the expected object hash recorded in transfer state.
method.param: Persisted segmented transfer state to validate against.
Working-directory storage used to read the persisted object payload.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: True when the local object payload exists and matches the expected hash.

main.summary: Wraps segmented transfer request metadata and payload streams as an HTTP content envelope for upload operations.

field.name: Metadata
field.summary: Request metadata serialized into the segmented transfer envelope header.

field.name: Payload
field.summary: Readable payload stream written into the envelope body.

field.name: PayloadLength
field.summary: Declared number of payload bytes that belong to the envelope body.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create HTTP content that serializes metadata and payload as a segmented transfer envelope.
constructor.param: Request metadata to serialize into the envelope header.
Readable payload stream to include in the envelope body.
Declared number of payload bytes to write from the payload stream.

main.summary: Represents the prepared finite source chosen for a segmented upload session before local persistence metadata is written.

property.name: Source
property.summary: Readable source stream when the prepared source still needs a working-directory copy to be written locally.

property.name: Descriptor
property.summary: Descriptor that captures how the upload source should be reopened across session refresh and process restart.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Total finite content length represented by the prepared source.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a prepared segmented-upload source description.

param.name: source
param.summary: Readable source stream when local staging still needs to be written.

param.name: descriptor
param.summary: Descriptor that records the chosen source kind and reopen metadata.

param.name: length
param.summary: Total finite content length represented by the prepared source.

param.name: finalstreamsha512
param.summary: SHA512 hash of the final stream content represented by the prepared source.
